as_told.title: Nazi Kammler Stab advanced propulsion research

plain: During the Second World War, a secret Nazi weapons office run by SS General Hans Kammler is said to have worked on advanced technology off the books. Michels calls this rumors of "black world nuclear stuff" in Nazi Germany, meaning hidden, unacknowledged projects. The writer Nick Cook tells him it "was basically a special projects office run by SS General Hans Kammler". Cook calls it the Kammlerstab and places it in Czechoslovakia and Poland from 1942 to 1945. On a later episode Michels brings up the Kammler Stab again, this time as "interesting scientists" working on new ways to power aircraft, as an early forerunner of the secret programs the show looks into.
